topics.name: Repository Tree Inventory
topics.purpose: Define deterministic inventory of every file/artifact in the reconciliation tree with exact path, hash, media/type, source role and canonical participation state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each inventory run has explicit identity.
semantics.path_rule: Every discovered file path is recorded exactly.
semantics.hash_rule: Exact byte hash/profile is recorded where feasible.
semantics.type_rule: File media/semantic type classification is explicit.
semantics.participation_rule: Whether a file participates in active canonical graph is explicit.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unclassified machine-significant files remain findings rather than being guessed.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

references.purpose: Inventory feeds exact active source-set construction.
